title: USDZ Round-Trip — Load, Export, Re-Import
description: End-to-end check of the USDZ exporter. Loads the ResidentialBuilding USDZ into a temporary SceneModel, writes it back out with USDZExporter (ASCII .usda in a stored, aligned ZIP), then re-imports the exported bytes into the displayed SceneModel. If geometry, per-mesh transforms and UsdPreviewSurface materials survive the cycle, the re-imported model renders identically to the original. Browser only.
